hypothesis: Catalogue-visible fault-strike heterogeneity indicates transfer/intersection zones where an unmapped strand may continue beyond the mapped trace.
mechanism: Gaussian structure-tensor axial orientation entropy (spin-2 isotropy) times local visible-trace density; no thermal, geophysical, external, prior-prediction, or hidden-fault inputs.
named_non_fault_mimic: Digitization bends, dense mapped swarms, and non-geothermal fault intersections.

inputs.cached_feature_stack: registry/feature_receipt.json points to data/processed/stack.npy, absent in this checkout; deliberately unused because H82 is catalogue-only; no private rebuild

transform.density_scale: q95 of local density on footprint, computed from visible faults only
transform.edge_mode: constant zero; feature only used inside footprint
transform.catalogue_usage: visible mask only within each fold; full catalogue used only for final-dot exclusion

holdout.split: buffered whole-component quadrant draw, seeds 20 and 30, hide_frac=0.20, feature buffer=3 px, 12-pixel boundary erosion
holdout.bootstrap: paired 20 km physical blocks, 2000 draws, fixed seeds

canary.test: the sole H82 entropy feature alone against withheld positive pixels and footprint negatives more than 3 px from the full catalogue

uniqueness.preplacement: all 812 indexed public inventory TIFFs plus local siblings where readable; any |Spearman rho| > 0.90 stops. Report incomplete inventory/read errors fail-closed.
uniqueness.finaldots: same registry plus local siblings; any forward 3-px overlap > 0.70 or |Spearman rho| > 0.90 stops; dense witness is a literal blocker under Policy I17.

promotion: Negative unless primary H82 HOLDOUT-DTI lower 95% CI exceeds the frozen 0.152718 local incumbent, confirmation is directionally consistent, all canaries and uniqueness checks pass, shared writer validates, and separate selector approval exists. No slot is spent in this lane.
